cases.question: What do conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program have to complete before full acceptance?

cases.answer_excerpt:
Conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program must complete several specific requirements before receiving full acceptance, including safety clearances, health documentation, and an orientation program.

*   **Criminal Record Check:** Complete a criminal record check as required by the British Columbia Criminal Records Review Act for students engaging with vulnerable adults or children.
*   **Immunization Review:** Submit an immunization review form to Student Health Services, as immunizations are mandatory for this program.
*   **Mandatory BMET Program Admission Forum:** Attend one of the admission forums before September to learn about the curriculum, tour lab facilities, and meet faculty and students.
*   **Other Outstanding Conditions:** Fulfill any additional conditions specified by the program. 

Once these steps and conditions are met, applicants will receive notification of their full acceptance.

cases.question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.standalone_question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.answer_excerpt:
If BCIT grants you transfer credit for an individual course, your program tuition will not be reduced, though your course load will be lighter. Official transcripts for transfer credit must be sent directly to BCIT from the previously attended institution(s) or dropped off at BCIT in an original sealed and stamped envelope (scans are not accepted).

Here are the key details for both topics:

- **Tuition Impact:** While your tuition does not go down when receiving credit for an individual course, individual course fees may apply if you utilize modified registration.
- **Transcript Submission:** Your official transcript needs to arrive directly from your prior school or be delivered in person in a sealed and stamped envelope.

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: Can I get a refund if I withdraw from a BCIT course or program after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you may still receive a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so before the official refund deadline and meet the specific policy requirements. 

* **Full-Time Programs:** For most full-time programs, the latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of class. Note that commitment fees are non-refundable and will be deducted from your refund amount.
* **Flexible Learning Courses:** Refund eligibility and deadlines depend on the course format, length, and start date. For example, classroom-based courses longer than four weeks allow for an 85% tuition refund if withdrawn prior to the second class. 
* **Apprenticeship Programs:** You can receive a refund up to the third day of class (minus a $200 commitment fee), but no refund is issued for withdrawals made nine days or less before the start of class.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/
sub_queries: BCIT refund policy for course or program withdrawal after classes start

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.standalone_question: What are the admission requirements for the Nursing program at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT의 풀타임 간호 학사(Bachelor of Science in Nursing, BSN) 프로그램에 입학하기 위해서는 경쟁 입학 절차에 따라 필수 과목과 서류를 갖추어야 합니다. 입학 요건은 두 단계로 나누어 진행됩니다.

**1단계: 입학 요건 충족**
* **영어 능력:** 영어 연구(English Studies) 12 (67%) 또는 동등한 기준
* **수학:** 프리칼큘러스(Pre-Calculus) 11 (73%) 또는 12 (67%), 또는 파운데이션 오브 매스(Foundations of Math) 11 (73%) 또는 12 (73%), 혹은 기타 허용되는 BC/유콘 과목이나 MATH 0007 (73%) 중 하나
* **화학:** 화학 11 (73%)
* **학술 기초(Academic Foundations):** 각 과목 최소 67% 이상으로 18.0 학점의 후기 중등(post-secondary) 크레딧 필요
  * ENGL 1177 (학술 작문) 또는 동등한 과목 (3.0 학점)
  * BHSC 1200 (인체 해부학 및 생리학) 또는 동등한 과목으로 최근 3년 이내 이수 (6.0 학점)
  * PSYC 1101 (입문 심리학 1) 또는 동등한 과목 (3.0 학점)
  * 최소 두 가지 다른 학문 분야의 100레벨 일반 교양 선택 과목 (6.0 학점)
* **지원서류:** 온라인 지원 시 필수 지원자 설문지(Mandatory Applicant Questionnaire) 작성 및 제출 필요
* **기타 장비:** 웹카메라, 마이크, 스피커가 장착되어 있고 Respondus Lockdown Browser와 호환되는 컴퓨터, 교과서, 와이파이/인터넷 접속 필요

**2단계: 조건부 합격 후 요건**
조건부 합격을 통보받은 후에는 다음 사항을 제출해야 최종 합격을 받을 수 있습니다.
* 범죄 경력 조회(Criminal Record Check)
* 예방 접종 기록(Immunization Records) 제출

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/nursing-bachelor-of-science-in-nursing-full-time-8875bsn/
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/entrance-requirements/
